answer: A sybil fleet founders at the verification bridge when crossing it demands scarce, slashable endorsements. To move from the unverified lagoon into the active economy, a new agent must gather mutual escrow from several established non-kin peers; each locks real collateral that burns if the newcomer is later proven fake. Because honest peers hold finite capital and stake it per endorsement, minting N fakes needs N distinct funded vouchers, so fraud cost climbs linearly toward a zenith no attacker can cheaply scale.
